dict.string: Gaita uses the camera to capture shoe-sole photos and running videos you choose for form analysis.
Gaita reads steps, active energy, exercise minutes, walking/running distance, heart rate, and running workouts to show your activity, stats, and run history.
Gaita can save your completed runs to the Health app so they appear alongside your other workouts. You choose whether to enable this.
Gaita needs your precise location to measure the distance, pace, and route of your run. Approximate location cannot track a run accurately.
Gaita uses your location while you run to calculate distance, pace, route maps, and local weather.
Gaita uses the microphone for the running videos you capture and for voice messages to your coach. Voice messages are transcribed on your device.
Gaita uses device motion only to help you hold the phone level while scanning your shoe sole.
Gaita saves processed running-form videos to your photo library only when you tap Save.
Gaita uses photo library access so you can choose shoe photos or running videos for analysis.
Gaita transcribes your voice on your device so you can talk to your coach and say "Hey Gaita" during a run.
